message.content:
An editorial illustration for a magazine cover features two monochrome, stylized portraits against a gray background. In the foreground, a woman's face and shoulders are rendered in grayscale with high contrast. She has dark, chin-length hair, prominent cheekbones, and small hoop earrings. She wears a dark garment with a high collar and a scarf tied around her neck. Her expression is neutral with a slight, tight-lipped smile, and her gaze is directed forward.

Behind her and to the left, a man's head and upper chest are shown in profile, looking downward. He has short dark hair and a slender build, wearing a light-colored, buttoned shirt. The word "TEMPO" is printed in large red capital letters across the top. Below this, the text reads "11-17 AGUSTUS 2014". Further text at the top includes "PEPESAN KOSONG GUGATAN PRABOWO" and "SETENGAH HATI BATASI SUBSIDI BBM" separated by a slash. 

Large white text at the bottom center reads "MENGAPA RINI SOEMARNO" followed by smaller text: "MENGEPALAI TIM TRANSISI PEMERINTAHAN JOKOWI, BENARKAH IA TITIPAN MEGAWATI SOEKARNOPUTRI?". A barcode, price "RP 35.000", and website address are located at the bottom left. A red vertical stripe runs down the left edge.
